stories.title: Press Accountability or Press Purge? Trump Bans CNN, MS NOW and Politico From the White House
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Revokes Access for Outlets That Peddled Years of Fake News
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Bans Three News Outlets From White House in Authoritarian Escalation

stories.poll_option1_desc: Access is a privilege; biased outlets shouldn't get taxpayer-funded seats.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Punishing outlets for coverage is unconstitutional retaliation against the free press.

stories.title: Election Integrity or Voter Suppression? Court Halts Trump's Mail Ballot Rule as Postal Service Stops Work

stories.poll_option2_desc: States run elections; this is a federal power grab to suppress votes.

stories.poll_option2_desc: Caging people in tiny enclosures is cruel and un-American.

stories.title: Strength or Recklessness? Trump Weighs 'Annihilating' Iran's Leadership After Hormuz Tanker Attacks

stories.title: Ending Indoctrination or Gutting Schools? Education Dept Cancels Teacher Grants Over 'Divisive Ideologies'

stories.title: Affordability Crisis or Trump Boom? Gas Above $4 and 2026-High Mortgage Rates Shadow the Midterms

stories.poll_option2_desc: Tariffs, chaos, and war choices made everyday life more expensive.

stories.poll_option2_desc: Armed federal agents at polls scare voters away — that's the point.

stories.title: Fair Maps or Stolen Seats? Missouri Redistricting Chaos Lands Back at the Supreme Court
